content: API key leakage in HTTP test cassettes: vcr records full Authorization headers by default. Prevention: vcr::vcr_configure(filter_sensitive_data=list('REDACTED'=Sys.getenv('KEY'))). For httptest2: redact_headers('Authorization'). Prefer static hand-crafted mock JSON over recorded cassettes for LLM tests. Add cassette dirs to .Rbuildignore. Pre-commit hook: grep for sk-ant/Bearer in tests/ must return empty.
